results.author: Adso Dervensis
results.title: De Antichristo
results.note: Translation by Bernard McGinn in 'Apocalyptic Spirituality: Treatises and Letters of Lactantius, Adso of Montier-en-Der, Joachim of Fiore, the Spiritual Franciscans and Savonarola' (Paulist Press/SPCK, 1979/1980). This is the standard modern English translation of Adso's most famous work.

results.author: Adso Dervensis
results.title: De miraculis S. Waldeberti
results.note: No English translation found. This vita of Saint Waldebert is only available in Latin, primarily in Patrologia Latina vol. 137.

results.author: Adso Dervensis
results.title: De translatione et miraculis S. Basoli
results.note: No English translation found. This translation and miracles account for Saint Basolus remains in Latin only.

results.author: Adso Dervensis
results.title: Vita S. Basoli
results.note: No English translation found. The life of Saint Basolus is available only in Latin; no modern English translation appears to exist.

results.author: Adso Dervensis
results.title: Vita S. Bercharii
results.note: No English translation found. The life of Saint Bercharius, one of Adso's hagiographic works, remains untranslated into English.

results.author: Adso Dervensis
results.title: Vita S. Frodoberti
results.note: No English translation found. The life of Saint Frodobert of Troyes exists only in Latin editions.

results.author: Adso Dervensis
results.title: Vita S. Mansueti
results.note: No English translation found. The life of Saint Mansuetus (Mansuy) is available only in the Latin original.

results.author: Avitus Viennensis
results.title: Collatio episcoporum
results.note: No English translation found. This ecclesiastical work exists only in Latin; not included in known English translation collections.

results.author: Avitus Viennensis
results.title: De Mosaicae historiae gestis
results.note: English translations available: George W. Shea, 'The Poems of Alcimus Ecdicius Avitus' (Medieval & Renaissance Texts & Studies, 1997) and Michael Roberts, 'Biblical and Pastoral Poetry' (Harvard University Press/Dumbarton Oaks Medieval Library, 2022).

results.author: Avitus Viennensis
results.title: Epistolae
results.note: English translation: Danuta Shanzer and Ian Wood, 'Avitus of Vienne: Selected Letters and Prose' (Translated Texts for Historians series 38, Liverpool University Press, 2002). This is a scholarly translation with annotations.

results.author: Avitus Viennensis
results.title: Fragmenta Libri de divinitate Spiritus Sancti
results.note: No English translation found. This short theological fragment (263 words) is not included in any known English translation collection.

results.author: Avitus Viennensis
results.title: Fragmenta
results.note: No English translation found. These miscellaneous fragments exist in Latin only, though some may be partially covered by Shanzer & Wood or Roberts translations.

results.author: Avitus Viennensis
results.title: Homilia de rogationibus
results.note: No English translation found. This homily on the Rogation Days exists in Latin only and does not appear in major English translation collections.

results.author: Avitus Viennensis
results.title: Sermo in rogationibus
results.note: No English translation found. This sermon on Rogation Days is available only in Latin.

results.author: Baldricus Dolensis
results.title: Vita
results.note: No English translation found. This biographical vita is available only in Latin editions.

results.author: Baldricus Dolensis
results.title: Acta translationis capitis S. Valentini
results.note: No English translation found. This account of Saint Valentine's head translation is available only in Latin.

results.author: Baldricus Dolensis
results.title: Carmen
results.note: No English translation found. This short poem (222 words) is not included in available English translation collections.

results.author: Baldricus Dolensis
results.title: Carmina
results.note: No English translation found. These poems exist in Latin only.

results.author: Baldricus Dolensis
results.title: Historia Hierosolymitana
results.note: English translation: Susan B. Edgington (translator) and Steven J. Biddlecombe (introduction), 'Baldric of Bourgueil: History of the Jerusalemites' (Crusading in Context series, Boydell Press, 2020). This is the first and standard modern English translation of this First Crusade source.

results.author: Baldricus Dolensis
results.title: Itinerarium sive epistola ad Fiscannenses
results.note: No English translation found. This travel narrative/letter to the Fiscanenses exists in Latin only.

results.author: Baldricus Dolensis
results.title: Vita S. Hugonis Rothomagensis
results.note: No English translation found. The life of Saint Hugh of Rouen is available only in Latin editions.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Alcuinus?)
results.title: Carmina
results.note: No English translation found. These poems attributed to or associated with Alcuin are available only in Latin.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Alcuinus?)
results.title: De divinis officiis
results.note: No English translation found. This work is now recognized as pseudo-Alcuin (a later Carolingian compilation) and remains in Latin only.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Alcuinus?)
results.title: Disputatio puerorum
results.note: English translation: Andrew Rabin and Liam Felsen, 'The Disputatio puerorum: A Ninth-Century Monastic Instructional Text' (Toronto Medieval Latin Texts series, Brepols, 2009). This scholarly edition provides the first complete modern English translation.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Alcuinus?)
results.title: Dubia alia
results.note: No English translation found. These dubious/miscellaneous works remain in Latin only.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Alcuinus?)
results.title: Homiliae
results.note: No English translation found. These homilies are available only in Latin.

results.author: Auctor incertus (Alcuinus?)
results.title: Propositiones ad juvenes acuendos
results.note: English translation: John Hadley (translator) with commentary by David Singmaster and John Hadley, 'Propositiones ad Acuendos Juvenes: Problems to Sharpen the Young' (1992 and earlier versions). This famous collection of medieval mathematical riddles has been translated multiple times.

results.author: Benedictus Anianensis
results.title: De regulis
results.note: No English translation found. This monastic work exists in Latin only.

results.author: Benedictus Anianensis
results.title: Epistolae
results.note: No English translation found. These letters are available only in Latin.

results.author: Benedictus Anianensis
results.title: Item praefatio
results.note: No English translation found. This preface exists in Latin only.

results.author: Benedictus Anianensis
results.title: Opuscula
results.note: No English translation found. These minor works are available only in Latin.

results.author: Benedictus Anianensis
results.title: Praefatio
results.note: No English translation found. This preface exists in Latin only.

results.author: Benedictus Anianensis
results.title: De concordia regularum
results.note: No complete English translation found. This major monastic work (108,797 words) exists in Latin critical editions (Bonnerue, CCSL vol. 168/168A, 1999; PL vol. 103) but no published complete English translation is known.

results.author: Hermannus Contractus
results.title: Carmen de conflictu ovis et lini
results.note: No English translation found. This poetic work (the debate between sheep and flax) is available only in Latin.

results.author: Hermannus Contractus
results.title: Chronicon
results.note: Partial English translations exist in scholarly contexts (e.g., in 'The Musica of Hermannus Contractus' by Boydell & Brewer, which includes selected biographical passages in English in Appendix 1), but no complete English translation of the full Chronicon has been published. Only Latin editions of the complete work are available.

results.author: Hermannus Contractus
results.title: De mensura astrolabii
results.note: No English translation found. This treatise on astrolabe measurement exists in Latin only.

results.author: Hermannus Contractus
results.title: De utilitatibus astrolabii
results.note: No English translation found. This work on the uses of the astrolabe is available only in Latin.

results.author: Hermannus Contractus
results.title: Opuscula musica
results.note: No English translation found. These musical works/treatises exist in Latin only.

results.author: Hermannus Contractus
results.title: Sequentia de B. Maria Virgine
results.note: This work is likely identical to or closely related to the Salve Regina, which has liturgical English translations (e.g., 'Hail, Holy Queen'), but whether these count as scholarly English translations of the work as a literary text is ambiguous. The original Latin sequence exists; modern English liturgical versions are available.

results.author: Maurini
results.title: Epistola nuncupatoria
results.note: No English translation found. This dedicatory letter by the Maurist editors is scholarly apparatus to the Patrologia Latina rather than an independent work requiring translation.

results.author: Maurini
results.title: Praefatio generalis
results.note: No English translation found. This general preface by the Maurist editors is editorial material in Latin; not a work typically translated into English.

results.author: Maurini
results.title: Praefatio
results.note: No English translation found. This preface is Maurist editorial apparatus in Latin only.

results.author: Maurini
results.title: Admonitio
results.note: No English translation found. This editorial notice by the Maurist editors is Latin apparatus material.

results.author: Maurini
results.title: Sancti Aurelii Augustini Hipponiensis Vita (1734)
results.note: No English translation found. This is a biographical preface by the Maurist editors (not Possidius's original Vita) introducing their edition of Augustine. It exists only in Latin as editorial material.

results.author: Maurini
results.title: Sancti Gregorii Papae I vita (1776)
results.note: No English translation found. This is a biographical introduction by the Maurist editors (not the 9th-century Giovanni Immonide vita) to their Gregory I edition. It remains in Latin as editorial material.
